request:
Create an enemy-mob-32 sprite named "Phaseglass Jackal".

Creative brief
Name: Phaseglass Jackal
Collection: Arcane Menagerie. Wild creatures altered by concentrated magic, with crystalline anatomy, runes, echoes, orbiting objects, and unusual projectile behavior.
Core concept: A phasing runner that swaps position with one of its own projectiles.
Body and silhouette: Tall narrow jackal with long ears, angular legs, and a glass-like ribcage.
Signature features: Transparent torso window, floating shoulder shards, and a bright tail tip.
Palette and materials: Smoky violet, dark navy, pale cyan, and glassy silver.
Movement personality: Elusive, calculating, and unnaturally smooth.
Attack concept: Fires one large slow crystal orb, flashes clearly, and swaps places with that orb after a fixed delay.
Directional details: The left shoulder shard is larger than the right.
Avoid: Egyptian clothing, fully invisible body, teleport without a visible anchor.
